fixed.member: render CPU time of large still scenes
fixed.summary: The renderer's CPU work per frame no longer grows with the instances that hold still: the sorted batches compare the submission in its own order and recompute only the instances that changed, a frame under TAA or motion blur where no instance moved builds and uploads no previous-transform records (its motion vectors read the instances themselves, as they did), and a scene without foliage meshes no longer walks every instance for foliage bounds. Frames are unchanged. A still city of 94,865 instances under TAA went from 32 to 13 ms of `render` CPU a frame on a software Vulkan device; with one instance moving, from 30 to 22 ms.
